title: Depth Block
author: Cal Newport
summary: A focused-work protocol inspired by Deep Work, expressed in original Methodra language. The full book framework is not presented as experimentally proven.
steps: Choose a start and stop time.
Capture unrelated thoughts without switching tasks.
Record focused minutes and the produced artifact.
End with a restart note or shutdown ritual.
evidenceNote: Level C for the complete collection. Attention-residue and interruption components can be linked separately to relevant research.

title: Self-Image Rehearsal
author: Maxwell Maltz
summary: A reflection that converts identity language into one observable action in an upcoming difficult situation.
steps: Describe the person you want to become in behavioral terms.
Mentally rehearse one upcoming difficult situation.
Specify the observable action that identity would take.
Compare rehearsal with what actually happened during review.
evidenceNote: Level C/D reflection. Methodra does not claim visualization reprograms the brain or guarantees outcomes.

title: Knowledge Portfolio
author: David Thomas & Andrew Hunt
summary: A developer protocol for turning technical reading into a small working artifact and maintained skill investment.
steps: Use a tracer-bullet implementation to test direction.
evidenceNote: Level C practical framework. The protocol is an original Methodra implementation inspired by the book.

title: Learn by Retrieval
author: Peter C. Brown, Henry L. Roediger III & Mark A. McDaniel
summary: An accessible study collection combining retrieval, spacing, varied practice, and corrective feedback.
steps: Space the next retrieval rather than repeating immediately.
Vary problem forms when the material supports it.
evidenceNote: The book collection is Level C as a synthesis; specific retrieval and spacing claims should cite primary learning research separately.
